title: MOFA solemnly refutes false claims regarding Taiwan in China-Russia joint communiqué
text:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) strongly refutes false claims made in a joint communiqué between the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and the Russian Federation. In the communiqué, which was signed on October 21 following the 31st regular meeting of the Chinese and Russian heads of government, the two nations put forward a misleading interpretation of United Nations General Assembly Resolution 2758, while Russia reiterated its adherence to the so-called “one China principle.” These claims contradict the facts and seek to seriously undermine Taiwan’s sovereignty.

MOFA strongly condemns the PRC government for persisting in international collusion to disseminate erroneous narratives that denigrate Taiwan’s sovereignty and escalate tensions across the Taiwan Strait. It also expresses deep regret at Russia’s subservience to authoritarian China.

MOFA reiterates that the Republic of China (Taiwan) is a sovereign and independent country and that neither the ROC (Taiwan) nor the PRC is subordinate to the other. All attempts to distort Taiwan’s sovereign status are acts of bullying that disrupt international peace and stability. No number of falsehoods can alter the internationally recognized status quo across the Taiwan Strait.

MOFA urges allies and friendly countries to continue to express concern over Taiwan Strait issues at international events and demonstrate firm positions in support of peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. Taiwan will continue to strengthen its self-defense capabilities, build whole-of-society defense resilience, and work closely with allies and friendly countries to jointly preserve freedom, openness, peace, and prosperity in Taiwan and throughout the Indo-Pacific region. (E)
